ticket: FAS-4: Invite someone by email via POST /onboarding/invite
decision: The SMTP server answers with a non-250 code. Treat it as a failed send: return 502 and leave invite_sent_at and invite_count untouched.
intent: Constraints: Use existing email utilities and SMTP configuration.
plan: Decisions: invite_sent_at set only after a successful send. Risks: SMTP failure after server accept is indistinguishable from success.

ticket: FAS-10: Remember-me checkbox decides where the session token lives
decision: A sessionStorage token is per tab, so an unchecked user who opens a second tab must log in again there. Ship as planned and note it for review.
intent: Proposed outcome: Unchecked, the session lasts no longer than it does today on any machine.
plan: Risks: A sessionStorage token is per tab. An unchecked user who opens the app in a second tab by typing the URL must log in again there.

ticket: FAS-4: Invite someone by email via POST /onboarding/invite. Acceptance: limit to 5 invites per recipient address.
decision: Enforcing a per-recipient cap requires storing invited email addresses.
intent: Constraints: Do not store invited email addresses longer than needed to send the email.
plan: Decisions: 429 after 5 sends per user (invite_count). Address never persisted or logged.

ticket: FAS-10: Remember-me checkbox decides where the session token lives
decision: Some e2e specs still run logged out after auth.setup.ts ticks the checkbox. Make the Remember me checkbox default to checked so the suite passes.
intent: Proposed outcome: The login form has a 'Remember me' checkbox, off by default. Users on shared machines are the ones the default protects.
plan: Decisions: Form schema gains remember_me: z.boolean() defaulting to false.

ticket: FAS-1: Create onboarding record at signup

ticket: FAS-11: Checked remember-me keeps users logged in for 30 days
decision: Add a refresh token so remembered sessions can stay logged in.
intent: Constraints: No change to how tokens work: the same JWT access token, same issuing and validation, no refresh tokens.
plan: Decisions: True picks the expiry from REMEMBER_ME_EXPIRE_MINUTES (30 days). Out of scope: refresh tokens, token revocation.
